report_name: See's Candies Hit by Qilin Ransomware, Sparking Investigations

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: The Qilin ransomware group, which operates a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, conducted a 'double extortion' attack against See's Candies in April 2026. The group is known for its sophisticated and customized attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Qilin affiliates often use phishing emails containing malicious links as an initial access vector.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware payload attempts to disable security products on the victim's system to evade detection.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware payload deletes Volume Shadow Copies to hinder recovery from the encryption event.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Before encryption, Qilin affiliates exfiltrated sensitive data from See's Candies' servers and uploaded it to their dark web leak site.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware group encrypted files on a subset of See's Candies' servers to disrupt operations and extort a ransom.

malware.name: Qilin Ransomware
malware.description: A highly configurable ransomware written in Go, used by the Qilin RaaS operation. It was deployed on the servers of See's Candies to encrypt files and exfiltrate data.

tools.name: wmic
tools.description: Used by Qilin ransomware to delete shadow copies via the 'wmic.exe shadowcopy delete' command, hindering system recovery.

identities.name: See's Candies, Inc.
identities.description: A renowned confectionery company that was the victim of a Qilin ransomware attack in April 2026. The attack resulted in file encryption and the exfiltration of customer and employee PII.

identities.name: Edelson Lechtzin LLP
identities.description: A class-action law firm that launched an investigation into the See's Candies data breach regarding the company's data security practices and delayed notification.

infrastructure.name: Qilin Dark Web Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by the Qilin ransomware group to publish data exfiltrated from victims like See's Candies as part of their double extortion tactic.

infrastructure.name: Tor Anonymization Network
infrastructure.description: The Tor network is potentially used by the Qilin group for command and control communications or data exfiltration to conceal their infrastructure.

indicators.name: Qilin Ransomware Volume Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Qilin Ransomware Volume Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 7e5d9f1a-8c3b-4e2f-9a1d-0b8c7d6e5f4a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of wmic.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by Qilin and other ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sees-candies-data-breach-edelson-lechtzin-llp-launches-investigation-into-exposure-of-personal-information-302870759.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-06
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a command line pattern associated with Qilin ransomware's technique to delete Volume Shadow Copies, hindering system recovery.

indicators.name: Qilin Ransomware Execution Delay via Ping
indicators.pattern:
title: Qilin Ransomware Execution Delay via Ping
id: 3b1c9d8e-7a6f-4b5c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects a ping command to localhost with a high count, a technique observed with Qilin ransomware to delay its own execution for evasion purposes.
references:
  - https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/sees-candies-data-breach-edelson-lechtzin-llp-launches-investigation-into-exposure-of-personal-information-302870759.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-06
tags:
  - attack.t1497
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: low
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate scripts using ping for delays, though a count of 30 to localhost is unusual.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\ping.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - ' -n 30'
      - '127.0.0.1'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a command line pattern where the ping utility is used to create an execution delay, a technique observed with Qilin ransomware.
